text.tspan: Sex gap in life expectancy at age 45
The sex gap period life expectancy (females minus males), for people who have reached the age of 45. Positive
values indicate higher life expectancy among females; negative values indicate higher life expectancy among
Data source: Human Mortality Database (2025); UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
